field_spec.request_id: uint32 of the I1 v2 header (int, or hex text)
field_spec.sequence: P1: nonce sequence (uint64) read from the frame
field_spec.result: OK when the 64 B response was sent, else an error code (no response)
field_spec.q_sha256: SHA-256 hex of q (C*L int8 bytes) after unprotect
field_spec.scale_sha256: SHA-256 hex of the C scales as FP16 little-endian
field_spec.logits: 5 FP32 as sent: '3f800000,...' (bit patterns, hex) or a list of 5 numbers
field_spec.label: argmax of the logits (first maximum); optional
field_spec.len: request frame length in bytes after reassembly; optional
field_spec.t_rx_ms: time the complete request was received (ms, any monotonic clock); optional
field_spec.t_tx_done_ms: time the response was sent (ms, same clock); optional
